summary: Early on Thursday, August 13, 2026, information technology employees at the Plymouth County Correctional Facility in Massachusetts detected an intruder who had bypassed the jail's security system and accessed its servers. The computer system was shut down immediately, which prevented retrieval of visitor security documents and suspended in-person visits. State Police, the FBI and DHS investigated; the sheriff's office said physical security was never at risk and there was no evidence personal information had been misused, but it was unclear what information, if any, was accessed, and employees were urged to monitor their accounts and credit reports.
